module Library.Tests where

import Library
import Library.Book
import Library.Disc

import Daml.Script

test = do
  alice <- allocateParty "alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "bob"
  charlie <- allocateParty "charlie"

  library1 <- submit [bob, alice, charlie] do
    createCmd Library with
      items = []
      members = [alice, bob, charlie]

  book1 <- submit alice do
    createCmd Book with
      owner = alice
      author = "Tolkien"
      title = "The Hobbit"
      loanedTo = None
      observers = []

  (library2, book2) <- submit alice do
      exerciseCmd library1 Library_Donate with
        owner = alice
        item = toInterfaceContractId book1

  disc1 <- submit bob do
    createCmd Disc with
      owner = bob
      title = "The Hobbit"
      format = BluRay
      borrowedBy = None
      observers = []

  (library3, disc2) <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd library2 Library_Donate with
      owner = bob
      item = toInterfaceContractId disc1

  (library4, book3) <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd library3 Library_TakeOut with
      borrower = bob
      item = book2

  submitMustFail charlie do
    exerciseCmd library4 Library_TakeOut with
      borrower = charlie
      item = book3

  (library5, book4) <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd library4 Library_GiveBack with
      borrower = bob
      item = book3

  (library6, book5) <- submit charlie do
    exerciseCmd library5 Library_TakeOut with
      borrower = charlie
      item = book4

  pure ()

      controller owner
      do view <$> fetch item

readView : Party -> ContractId CatalogItem -> Script CatalogItemView
readView owner item = script do
  reader <- submit owner do createCmd (ViewReader owner)
  submit owner do exerciseCmd reader ReadView with item

viewMatches : CatalogItemView -> CatalogItemView -> Bool
viewMatches actual expected =
  actual.owner == expected.owner && actual.media == expected.media &&
  actual.title == expected.title && actual.loanedTo == expected.loanedTo

bookViewAndCreation : Script ()
bookViewAndCreation = script do
  owner <- allocateParty "book-owner"
  observer <- allocateParty "book-observer"
  original <- submit owner do createCmd (book owner [observer])
  let item : ContractId CatalogItem = toInterfaceContractId original
  itemView <- readView owner item
  assert (viewMatches itemView (bookView owner None))
  visible <- query @Book observer
  assert (visible == [(original, book owner [observer])])

bookDisclosure : Script ()
bookDisclosure = script do
  owner <- allocateParty "disclosure-owner"
  oldObserver <- allocateParty "existing-observer"
  newObserver <- allocateParty "new-observer"
  anotherObserver <- allocateParty "another-observer"
  original <- submit owner do createCmd (book owner [oldObserver])
  let item : ContractId CatalogItem = toInterfaceContractId original
  disclosed <- submit owner do exerciseCmd item CatalogItem_Disclose with observers = [oldObserver, newObserver, anotherObserver]
  contracts <- query @Book owner
  let expected = book owner [oldObserver, newObserver, anotherObserver]
  assert (length contracts == 1)
  assert (map snd contracts == [expected])
  assert (map (toInterfaceContractId . fst) contracts == [disclosed])
  newObserverContracts <- query @Book newObserver
  assert (newObserverContracts == contracts)
  oldObserverContracts <- query @Book oldObserver
  assert (oldObserverContracts == contracts)
  disclosedView <- readView owner disclosed
  assert (viewMatches disclosedView (bookView owner None))
  again <- submit owner do exerciseCmd disclosed CatalogItem_Disclose with observers = [newObserver, oldObserver]
  againContracts <- query @Book owner
  assert (map snd againContracts == [expected])
  assert (map (toInterfaceContractId . fst) againContracts == [again])

bookLoanAndReturn : Script ()
bookLoanAndReturn = script do
  owner <- allocateParty "loan-owner"
  borrower <- allocateParty "loan-borrower"
  observer <- allocateParty "loan-observer"
  original <- submit owner do createCmd (book owner [observer])
  let originalItem : ContractId CatalogItem = toInterfaceContractId original
  loaned <- submit owner do exerciseCmd originalItem CatalogItem_LoanTo with borrower
  loanView <- readView owner loaned
  assert (viewMatches loanView (bookView owner (Some borrower)))
  loanedBooks <- query @Book owner
  assert (map snd loanedBooks == [(book owner [observer]) with loanedTo = Some borrower])
  assert (map (toInterfaceContractId . fst) loanedBooks == [loaned])
  borrowerBooks <- query @Book borrower
  assert (borrowerBooks == [])
  observerBooks <- query @Book observer
  assert (observerBooks == loanedBooks)
  returned <- submitMulti [owner, borrower] [] do exerciseCmd loaned CatalogItem_ReturnToOwner
  returnedView <- readView owner returned
  assert (viewMatches returnedView (bookView owner None))
  returnedBooks <- query @Book owner
  assert (map snd returnedBooks == [book owner [observer]])
  assert (map (toInterfaceContractId . fst) returnedBooks == [returned])
  assert (originalItem /= loaned && loaned /= returned)
  borrowedAgain <- submit owner do exerciseCmd returned CatalogItem_LoanTo with borrower
  borrowedAgainView <- readView owner borrowedAgain
  assert (viewMatches borrowedAgainView (bookView owner (Some borrower)))
  disclosedWhileLoaned <- submit owner do exerciseCmd borrowedAgain CatalogItem_Disclose with observers = [borrower, observer]
  disclosedView <- readView owner disclosedWhileLoaned
  assert (viewMatches disclosedView (bookView owner (Some borrower)))
  disclosedBooks <- query @Book owner
  assert (map snd disclosedBooks == [(book owner [observer, borrower]) with loanedTo = Some borrower])
  assert (map (toInterfaceContractId . fst) disclosedBooks == [disclosedWhileLoaned])
  borrowerVisible <- query @Book borrower
  assert (borrowerVisible == disclosedBooks)
  finalReturn <- submitMulti [owner, borrower] [] do exerciseCmd disclosedWhileLoaned CatalogItem_ReturnToOwner
  finalBooks <- query @Book owner
  assert (map snd finalBooks == [book owner [observer, borrower]])
  assert (map (toInterfaceContractId . fst) finalBooks == [finalReturn])

bookRejectsUnauthorizedActions : Script ()
bookRejectsUnauthorizedActions = script do
  owner <- allocateParty "rights-owner"
  observer <- allocateParty "rights-observer"
  stranger <- allocateParty "rights-stranger"
  borrower <- allocateParty "rights-borrower"
  original <- submit owner do createCmd (book owner [observer])
  let item : ContractId CatalogItem = toInterfaceContractId original
  submitMustFail observer do exerciseCmd item CatalogItem_LoanTo with borrower
  submitMustFail stranger do exerciseCmd item CatalogItem_LoanTo with borrower
  submitMustFail observer do exerciseCmd item CatalogItem_Disclose with observers = [stranger]
  submitMustFail stranger do exerciseCmd item CatalogItem_Disclose with observers = [stranger]
  submitMustFail owner do exerciseCmd item CatalogItem_ReturnToOwner
  loaned <- submit owner do exerciseCmd item CatalogItem_LoanTo with borrower
  submitMustFail owner do exerciseCmd loaned CatalogItem_LoanTo with borrower = stranger
  submitMustFail owner do exerciseCmd loaned CatalogItem_ReturnToOwner
  submitMustFail observer do exerciseCmd loaned CatalogItem_ReturnToOwner
  returned <- submitMulti [owner, borrower] [] do exerciseCmd loaned CatalogItem_ReturnToOwner
  submitMustFail owner do exerciseCmd returned CatalogItem_ReturnToOwner
